description: Plagueheart Robe Level 60 Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Robe if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Robe - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 25 - Mooncloth x 4 - Nexus Crystal x 2
